packet.title: EXI design and headers
packet.summary: Records and writes every public declaration of Phase 8: include/sxml/exi.h, the exi method and its parameters in serialize.h, the namespaces in name.h, the feature, resource kind and processor functions in processor.h.

item.p: Owns: new include/sxml/exi.h, src/exi.c (the lifecycles, encode and decode returning SXML_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE until their packets), src/exi_internal.h; additive changes to include/sxml/serialize.h, name.h (SXML_NAMESPACE_EXI, SXML_NAMESPACE_EXI_FORMAT; ), processor.h, and the switches that list the enumerations they grow.
Done when: every preset builds; the existing tests pass.
